_comment: Supported releases (GOV-01/02). 'version' names a minor series: every patch release of 0.1 shares one support window. Policy: the current series plus the previous one (N-1) are supported; when a new series ships, the previous one gets a sunset date 90 days later. After its sunset date a repo on that series fails CI (ENT-060); within 90 days of it CI warns (ENT-061). Edit this file in the same change that releases a new version.
